name: Venture to Future Fund
decision_note: State-backed Slovak VC fund (EIB, MF SR and RRP money via SIH) investing first tickets of EUR 0.4-2m (up to 7m incl. follow-ons) pari passu with private co-investors; co-invested in FaceUp in May 2026 and Talentiqa in Sept 2025.

funds.name: Venture to Future Fund (RRP capital increase)

evidence.quote: Venture to Future Fund, a.s. - IČO: 52380483
Minimálna výška našej investície je 400tis. EUR, aj keď optimálne investujeme medzi 1,5 – 2,0 mil. EUR.
Podporujeme vizionárskych zakladateľov a tímy, ktoré prinášajú inovácie v rôznych sektoroch.

Cielime na malé a stredné podniky v rastovej fáze od neskoršieho Seed kola po Series A,B s aspoň čiastočne funkčným produktom, ktorý je životaschopný, bol otestovaný na trhu a má už prvých platiacich zákazníkov alebo dojednané zmluvné vzťahy.
Zameriavame sa predovšetkým spoločnosti založené a pôsobiace na Slovensku a zahraničné spoločnosti (EÚ) s kapitálovým prepojením na Slovensko, ktoré podporujú inovácie a rast v regióne.
V rokoch 2020 - 2026 máme vyčlenených 55 mil. EUR, aby sme našli a zafinancovali práve váš projekt.
Kapitálovo do nej vstupujú dvaja renomovaní hráči na slovenskom investičnom trhu, fond rizikového kapitálu Venture to Future Fund a IT spoločnosť Soitron.
Slovenský Venture to Future Fund týmto krokom rozširuje portfólio investorov, medzi ktorých patrí aj SpeedUp Venture Capital Group, Zero Gravity Capital, Lighthouse Ventures a P&J Capital.
Venture to Future Fund (VFF), investičný fond zameraný na podporu inovatívnych slovenských firiem s globálnym potenciálom, oznámil navýšenie kapitálu o 15,3 milióna eur.
Individual investors have endowed the VFF with funds totalling €40.4 million.
Výška investície sa pohybuje od 400 tisíc eur až do 7 miliónov eur, čo je navýšenie z pôvodných 4,9 miliónov.
Do investičního kola se kromě JIC Ventures zapojily také fondy Venture to Future Fund a Gi21 Capital.
The round was equally backed by Purple Ventures and Venture to Future Fund.

Venture to Future Fund s radosťou oznamuje, že v spolupráci so Seed Starterom Slovenskej sporiteľne uzavrel Series A investičné kolo vo výške 1 milión EUR s cieľom podpory globálneho rastu dynamického slovenského startupu Vestberry.
Other investors include Venture to Future Fund and Zero One Hundred
SCM spravuje fond Venture to Future Fund, a.s. (VFF), ktorý je zameraný na investície do slovenských inovatívnych spoločností.
Slovak Capital Management, a. s. - IČO: 51865513
The funding round was led by Purple Ventures II, with contributions from existing investors Venture to Future Fund and Vision Ventures, as Presto Ventures informed Vestbee.
Vieme byť pomerne flexibilní a prispôsobiť výšku investície potrebám vášho projektu až do výšky 7mil. EUR, vrátane follow-on investícií.

analyst_notes: Capital derived: EUR 40.4m initial capital (SIH page, e10) + EUR 15.3m RRP top-up announced 28 May 2024 (e9) = EUR 55.7m; the VFF homepage rounds this to '55 mil. EUR' for 2020-2026 (e6). Investment period extended to end-2026 by the top-up; fund life 10 years. Ticket: site says minimum EUR 400k, optimal 1.5-2.0m, up to 7m incl. follow-ons (e2, e11); SLOVCA profile (self-reported, older) still says 0.5-4.8m. Always co-invests pari passu (50:50) with an independent private co-investor. The VFF record is the fund vehicle itself (a.s., IČO 52380483, RÚZ ownership type 'Štátne', SK NACE 64300); it was set up by the EIB and MF SR through Slovak Investment Holding (SIH, slovak-investment-holding), which promotes it as its financial instrument; NBS export (2026-10-24) lists it as 'registrovaný alternatívny investičný fond' from 2025-01-20 (its manager, Slovak Capital Management, a. s., IČO 51865513, SIH group, is on the NBS export as a registered AIF manager from 2025-01-20; SIH states SCM manages VFF, e16, e17). FaceUp round size: Forbes headline says over CZK 110m in the round, amount left null. Further 2025-2026 deals reported only by aggregators (PitchBook/CB Insights: IAG May 2025, Sloneek 16 Jun 2026 with Orbit Capital) were not cited. Talentiqa is described as Prague-based (AIN) although other sources say Ostrava; both CZ. SLOVCA full member. Vestberry follow-on of 14 Mar 2025 (EUR 2.2m round led by Seed Starter of Česká a Slovenská sporiteľňa, with Zero One Hundred) cited from AIN (e15). Reviewer: Slovak Capital Management, a. s. added as manager legal entity; the NBS-register analyst's dossier slovak-capital-management (E10 duplicate) points to this record. Sloneek: VFF was an existing investor in the EUR 3.6m late-seed round led by Purple Ventures II (Vestbee, 10 Sep 2024, e18); the June 2026 Sloneek round reported by aggregators remains uncited. [revision 2026-10-25 after review: capital basis changed from latest_fund_size to cumulative_fund_sizes - EUR 55.7m is the derived sum of two capital injections into the one fund vehicle (EUR 40.4m initial endowment, e10, plus the EUR 15.3m RRP capital increase announced 2024-05-28, e9), not a final close of a raised fund; amount, as-of date (2024-05-28) and method 'derived' unchanged, consistent with the homepage's '55 mil. EUR' for 2020-2026 (e6). Manager legal entity Slovak Capital Management, a. s. (IČO 51865513) kept.] [revision 2026-10-25 after review round 2: ticket_size changed from EUR 400k-7m to EUR 400k-2.0m (first ticket), stated - the homepage gives the minimum investment as EUR 400k and the optimal range as EUR 1.5-2.0m (e2); the EUR 7m maximum includes follow-on investments ('až do výšky 7mil. EUR, vrátane follow-on investícií', e19), so it is a total per-company maximum, not a first ticket. The 2.0m upper bound is the top of the stated optimal range, not a hard cap; no separate first-ticket maximum is published. e11 (2024-05-28: 'from EUR 400k up to EUR 7m', raised from 4.9m) is no longer cited for the ticket but is kept as the dated source of the follow-on maximum. The decision_note's 'EUR 0.4-7m' describes the total per-company range including follow-ons.]
